titre: Synthesis Test n°1 — English (6th year primary)

exercices.enonce:
Read the text:
Leila is a pupil in the sixth year. She goes to school from Monday to Friday. Her school starts at eight o'clock in the morning. On Monday, she has Maths, Arabic and Sport. Her favourite subject is English because it is easy and fun. At ten o'clock, the pupils have a break in the playground. Leila eats a sandwich and plays with her friends. School finishes at four o'clock. After school, she does her homework.

Answer:
1) In which year is Leila? (1 pt)
2) When does her school start? (1 pt)
3) What is her favourite subject? Why? (1,5 pt)
4) What does Leila do at ten o'clock? (1,5 pt)

Complete with: has / have / goes / plays
1) Leila ...... to school every day.
2) The pupils ...... a break at ten.
3) She ...... a favourite subject.
4) Leila ...... with her friends.

Write the days of the week in order:
Friday - Monday - Wednesday - Tuesday - Thursday
→ ...... , ...... , ...... , ...... , ......

Put the words in the right order:
1) at / starts / School / eight / . 
2) English / favourite / My / subject / is / . 
3) homework / does / She / her / .

Writing:
Write 4 to 5 sentences about your school day (when it starts, your subjects, your break, when it finishes).

School timetable.
Complete with: subject - break - timetable - lesson.
1) English is my favourite .......... .
2) We have a .......... at ten o'clock.
3) Look at the .......... to know your classes.
4) Each .......... lasts about one hour.
